summary: VDD skill creates/repairs complete execution-plan directories only; standalone requirements Markdown routes to direct implementation. Select standard/resumable/self-hosted profile before model routing; record profile rationale. Required authority, clarification, lifecycle, knowledge-preflight, and skill-input gates precede plan-ready. Lifecycle: draft→plan-ready→implementation-authorized→implementation-complete→acceptance-passed→archived; ownership is distinct. Each slice needs behavior, failure intent, GREEN target, dependents, recovery; VDD does not own RED execution or fabricate legacy RED. Repairs are in-place under repair/round-n, preserve immutable history, bind findings/baselines/changed sets/callsites/composition receipts, and require terminal full validation. Resumable/self-hosted require append-only 95 report/index. Bootstrap review is optional, bounded by lineage and round rules; P2-only findings do not reopen semantic review. Knowledge selection must be hash-verified; blocked/invalid gates prevent plan-ready. Completion requires required artifacts, observable acceptance, recorded negative/legacy path, stable repairs, and current terminal full validation.
